name: Santa María de los Llanos (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white horizontal stripe through the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María de los Llanos (a castle, a cross of Saint James and an anchor).
history: Municipal flag of Santa María de los Llanos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa María de los Llanos arms — castle, cross of Saint James and anchor
